ancestries.name: Human
ancestries.blurb: Humans are restless, adaptable, and ambitious, at home anywhere and finished nowhere.
bloodlines: Allies within 15 feet gain a +1 Situation bonus to their first Defense roll each round while they can see or hear you.

cultures: A lowland order-state where nothing is real until it is written and witnessed. Serrovane settles its disputes by formal challenge, keeps its ledgers in triplicate, and considers a broken oath a more serious crime than the violence that follows it.
The trade-towns of a wide river delta, where six languages meet at every dock and a good broker is worth more than a good sword. Reach folk talk first, and are very good at it.
backgrounds: In a circus or on the streets, you earned your pay by performing as an acrobat. You might have turned to adventuring when the money dried up, or simply decided to put your skills to better use.

You served in somebody's army: a levy, a free company, a city watch that saw real fighting. You learned the drill, the marching, and the waiting, and you learned what a line looks like just before it breaks.

You made your living outside the law, whether by picking pockets, running contraband, or talking your way through doors that were meant to stay shut. You still know who to ask, and which questions never to.
callings: Sneak Attack: +1d6 precision damage vs. Off-Guard foes, rising to +2d6 at Expert, +3d6 at Master, and +4d6 at Legendary.
Rage ❶: Temporary Vigor equal to your level + Might, +2 melee damage, −1 Evade, and you are Heedless while it lasts. The damage rises to +4 at Expert, +6 at Master, +8 at Legendary.
Panache: held on a critical Strike, a Feint, or a Demoralize; +1 Situation to Evade and +1 ft to your Speeds while you hold it (Speed +2 ft at Expert, Evade +2 at Master, Speed +3 ft at Legendary).
Mark Prey ❶: +1d8 precision damage the first time each round you Hit your prey (2d8 at Expert, 3d8 at Master, 4d8 at Legendary), and you always know roughly where it is within 60 feet.
Drilled: Weapon Familiarity free; treat your Melee or Ranged Proficiency Bonus as 2 higher with that Weapon Group; and you may take Reactive Strike without being Expert in Melee.
defenses: Blights: poison, disease, and anything that must be caught early. Initiative is usually Awareness. Never unavailable.
Beguilement: Feint, Lie, Sneak, and illusions are measured against your Awareness Threshold.
Blows and Blasts. Unavailable while you are Grabbed or Restrained.
Blows (a ranged Blow only with a shield Raised). Unavailable while you are unaware of the attack, or have nothing equipped to ward it away.
Beguilement: fear, charm, confusion, and other assaults on your composure.
Blasts and Blights: poison, disease, exhaustion, Persistent Damage, and Recovery checks while Dying. Never unavailable.
postures: You Guard with a +2 Situation bonus. You need a rigid weapon, a shield, or a permitted natural weapon in hand. If you Stop a Deliberate or Committed Strike, you take Control of the attacking weapon rather than a neutral Bind, and you may at once make a Quick Strike ⓿ against its owner: the riposte. A Stopped Quick Strike gives only a neutral Bind.
You Evade with a +2 Situation bonus. If the attack is Stopped, you may Step in any direction.
Melee Training • Guard or Evade, no bonus

Answer a melee Blow from a foe within your Reach with a Quick Strike of your own. No bonus to your Defense. Roll both; resolve both. Both can land. You cannot Counter a Counter or an Intercept, and the fighter you Counter rolls only their basic Defense against it.

When a foe Moves from outside your Total Reach to inside it, or Strikes you with an Unwieldy weapon from inside its Unwieldy distance, make a Quick Strike at the moment they enter. Once per foe per Move. A Wound stops their movement; anything less and it continues.

A Situation bonus to the named Defense, taken before you know whether the attack succeeded. It costs no actions, but a Zone of your choice becomes Exposed until the end of the round, whether or not the Posture works, and Recenter does not clear it. Its bonus is Situation, the same type Parry and Void grant, so a Posture and a Parry or Void do not stack.
+2 Situation bonus to Evade for the triggering attack. A Zone of your choice becomes Exposed until the end of the round, win or lose; Recenter does not clear it.
+2 Situation bonus to Guard for the triggering attack. A Zone of your choice becomes Exposed until the end of the round, win or lose; Recenter does not clear it.

weaponTraits: Light enough to bite on the way in: a Quick Strike ❶ with it may Critically Hit.
You may attack with it while you are Grabbed, while Squeezing, and against a creature you have Grabbed, with no penalty.

On a critical hit, add one die of the listed size to the damage. It is a critical effect of the weapon rather than one of the dice rolled for damage, so it is added after the damage has been doubled, and is not itself doubled.
You may use Agility instead of Might on attack rolls with this weapon. Damage still uses Might.
It knocks out rather than kills.
A guard built for defense. +1 Gear bonus to Guard against melee Attacks while you wield it.
+1 Situation bonus to attack a target you have not yet attacked this round.
You may throw it up to X feet, using Might for the attack roll.
You may attempt that Maneuver with this weapon in hand rather than a free hand.
Wielded in two hands, its damage die becomes dX.

You take a −2 Situation penalty to attack rolls with it against a target within N feet, and you cannot attack with it at all while you are Grabbed. A creature within N feet that you attack with it may Intercept you, as though you had entered its Reach.
It cannot Parry, form a Bind, or be Bound. You can still Guard with it.
You may deal X damage instead of its usual type.

actionTraits: Attack
An action a foe answers with a Defense. Attacks are resolved as Exchanges (see Chapter 2: The Exchange). A Committed Strike ❸ is also Weighted.
Motion

You change position under your own power. Moving into a foe's Total Reach may provoke an Intercept from that foe; moving out of it may provoke a Reaction from anyone with a Talent that allows it. Step does neither.
Manipulate
You use your hands. You need at least one free, and fine work near an enemy can provoke a Reaction from them.
Concentrate
Maneuvers with this Trait take an extra action to complete if you are Heedless.
Stance
A way of standing and holding yourself. You can be in only one stance at a time, and it lasts until you leave it, fall unconscious, or enter another.
Auditory
It works through sound. It fails on the deafened, and on anyone who cannot hear you.
Visual
It works through sight. It fails on the blinded, and on anyone who cannot see you.
Mental
It works on the mind. It fails on anything mindless.
Emotion
A mental effect that works on feeling. Anything immune to emotion ignores it.
Reaction

A Maneuver you may perform outside your Opportunity, the moment its Trigger occurs. It costs its listed actions from the same six as everything else, and you may use as many Reactions in a round as you can afford. A Reaction never triggers another Reaction. Marked ↺ beside its cost.
Press

Actions with this trait follow up an earlier attack. You can use a Press action only if your previous action this round was a Strike against the same target, and only at your own Opportunity. Some actions with the Press trait also grant an effect on a failure. The effects that are added on a failure don't apply on a critical failure. If your Press action succeeds, you can choose to apply the failure effect instead (for example, when an attack deals no damage due to resistance).
Weighted
A Committed Strike ❸. If it is Stopped (a Graze or a Miss), you are Exposed in a Zone of the defender's choice.
Prepared
A Maneuver of three or more actions. Spend one action now and reserve the rest; it resolves at your next Opportunity (see Encounter Mode).
Flexible
A weapon that cannot Parry, form a Bind, or be Bound.
Massive
An attack so heavy that any Critical Hit Wounds, whether or not the Zone was Exposed. Reserved for the largest creatures.
Unparryable
An attack that cannot be answered with Parry and offers nothing to Bind. Guard still applies to it.

Motion: Move up to your Speed. Crossing into a foe's Total Reach may provoke an Intercept.

Move up to five times your Speed in a straight line, less your Load Strain in feet. You cannot use Reactions until your next Opportunity, and you are Off-Guard against any Intercept made against you during the Rush.
Jump 10 feet horizontally (less your Load Strain in feet) or 3 feet vertically, without a check. Longer or higher jumps are an Athletics check, and count as part of the Leap.
An Athletics check against a Threshold the GM sets. On a success you move half your Speed (your full Speed on a critical success). On a critical failure you fall.
An Athletics check against a Threshold the GM sets. On a success you move half your Speed (your full Speed on a critical success). On a critical failure you sink.

Acrobatics against the target's Awareness Threshold, to move through a foe's space. On a success you pass through, though their space is difficult terrain for this move. On a failure your movement stops in front of them.

Requirements You are entering a space narrower than your token size, but at least half as wide.
Move up to 3 feet, regardless of your Speed. While any part of you is in that space you are Off-Guard, Evade is unavailable to you, and you can attack only with weapons that have the Close trait. A space narrower than half your own stops you entirely: for a Medium creature, a gap of 1½ feet or less.
Attack:
Attack with a weapon or an unarmed blow. Roll Melee (or Ranged, for a weapon that leaves your hand) against Evade or Guard, and deal damage and effects as normal. The actions you spend say how much of yourself is behind the blow (see Chapter 2: The Exchange).
❶ Quick. A probe: one weapon die plus precision damage, nothing else, on the Torso. It cannot Critically Hit (Agile weapons excepted) and Protection applies in full even to an Exposed Zone. Stopped, it costs you nothing and can only be bound, never Controlled.
❷ Deliberate. All dice, specialization, and your Might. It may be placed on an Exposed Zone, and on a Critical Hit you may Expose a plausible Zone. A Graze costs only the tempo; on a Miss you are Exposed. A Parry that Stops it takes Control.
❸ Committed. Prepared. All dice, specialization, and your Might. On a Hit or Critical Hit, you may Expose a plausible Zone. Weighted: Stopped, Graze or Miss, you are Exposed. A Parry that Stops it takes Control.

Requirements A rigid weapon, shield, or permitted natural weapon in hand; the target's weapon or natural attack is within the longer of your two Total Reaches; the target is no more than one Size larger than you.
Roll Melee against the target's Guard.
Critical Success You Control the weapon, and the target is Off-Guard until its next Opportunity. Success You Control the weapon. Graze A neutral Bind forms. Miss You pressed badly. The target Controls your weapon instead.
Special Evade cannot answer this attack. While you Control a weapon, the target has an Exposed Zone of your choice and takes −2 Situation to attacks with it (see Chapter 2: The Exchange).

Requirements You Control a foe's weapon.
Step toward that foe. The Bind holds, and the Controlled weapon cannot Intercept you. This is the only movement that does not end a Bind.

Requirements You have a free hand or a weapon with the Grapple Trait, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard.
Critical Success The target is Restrained until the end of the next round. Success The target is Grabbed until the end of the next round. Graze No effect. Miss You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.
❷ Tackle. Move, then Grapple. Critical Success The target is Restrained until the end of the next round and knocked Prone. Success The target is Grabbed until the end of the next round and knocked Prone. You fall Prone adjacent to them. Graze No effect, and you are Exposed in a Zone of the defender's choice. Miss You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity, and fall Prone adjacent to them.

Requirements You have a free hand or a weapon with the Shove Trait, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard.
Critical Success The target is pushed 6 feet. You may Move as part of this action, if it is in the same direction. Success The target is pushed 3 feet. Graze No effect. Miss You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.
❷ Heave. You set your feet and put your weight behind it. Critical Success The target is pushed 12 feet. Success The target is pushed 6 feet. Graze No effect, and you are Exposed in a Zone of the defender's choice. Miss You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.

Requirements You have a free hand or a weapon with the Trip Trait, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard.
Critical Success The target is knocked Prone, and takes damage equal to your Might. Success The target is knocked Prone. Graze No effect. Miss You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.
Special If the target's Legs are Exposed, increase the degree of success by one.
❷ Leg Sweep. Critical Success The target is knocked Prone, takes damage equal to your Might, and becomes Exposed [Legs]. Success The target is knocked Prone and becomes Exposed [Legs]. Graze No effect, and you are Exposed in a Zone of the defender's choice. Miss You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity. The Special above still applies.

Requirements You have a free hand or a weapon with the Disarm Trait, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard.
Critical Success The item drops from their grip and lands in one of their squares. Success Their grip is loosened: −2 Situation penalty to attacks with it, and the next Disarm against them gains a +2 Situation bonus, until they spend an Interact to resettle it. Graze No effect. Miss You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.
Special If the target's Arms are Exposed, increase the degree of success by one.
❸ Wrench. Critical Success The item flies from their grip and lands 1d10 squares away, in a direction of your choosing. Success The item drops from their grip and lands in one of their squares. Graze No effect, and you are Exposed in a Zone of the defender's choice. Miss You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity. The Special above still applies.

Requirements You have a free hand or are already Grabbing or Restraining the target, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard.
Critical Success Move the target up to 6 feet, staying within your reach, not into or through obstacles. Success Move the target up to 3 feet, staying within your reach, not into or through obstacles. Graze No effect. Miss The target can move you up to 3 feet as though it Repositioned you.
❷ Haul. Critical Success Move up to your full Speed, bringing the target with you. Success Move up to half your Speed, bringing the target with you. Graze No effect, and you are Exposed in a Zone of the defender's choice. Miss The target can move you up to 6 feet the same way.
Defense & Recovery: Gain your shield's Gear bonus to Guard until your next Opportunity. You must be wielding it.
Gather yourself: clear every Exposed Zone on you (except one Exposed by a Posture) and end any Bind you are in.

Requirements You have Cover, or Greater Cover, or are wielding a tower shield.
Press yourself into your cover. Your Cover improves by one grade. Adjust the Zones Covered to match. This lasts until you Move, Step or Attack.
Special A raised tower shield gives you Cover with nothing to get behind, so Taking Cover behind one gives you Greater Cover.

Break free of a grab, a restraint, or anything holding you.
Requirements You are Grabbed or Restrained.
Roll your best of Athletics or Acrobatics against the grabber's Endure.
Critical Success You are no longer Grabbed or Restrained, and may Step ⓿. Success You are no longer Grabbed or Restrained. Failure The Grabbed or Restrained condition persists. Critical Failure The condition persists and their hold improves: if you were Grabbed, you are now Restrained.

Move up to half your Speed. Step has no Traits at all, which is the point: it never provokes Intercepts or other Reactions. Stepping ends any Bind you are in (Close excepted). You cannot Step into difficult terrain.

Requirements You have Guard Training, and a rigid weapon, shield, or permitted natural weapon in hand.
Answer an attack with Guard at a +2 Situation bonus. If you Stop a Deliberate or Committed Strike, you take Control of the attacking weapon instead of forming a neutral Bind, and you may at once make a Quick Strike ⓿ against its owner (the riposte). A Stopped Quick Strike gives only a neutral Bind.

Requirements You have Evade Training.
Answer an attack with Evade at a +2 Situation bonus. If the attack is Stopped, you may Step in any direction.

Requirements You have Melee Training; the attacker is within your Reach and the attack is a melee attack.
Answer the attack with a Quick Strike of your own. You gain no bonus to your Defense. Roll both; resolve both. You cannot Counter a Counter or an Intercept, and the fighter you Counter rolls only their basic Defense against it.

Requirements You have Melee Training.
Trigger A foe Moves from outside your Total Reach to inside it, or Strikes you with an Unwieldy weapon from inside its Unwieldy distance.
Make a Quick Strike against them at the moment they enter. Once per foe per Move. A Wound stops their movement; anything less and it continues.
Do nothing at this Opportunity. You may still use Reactions. When a full circuit passes in which everyone Passes, the round ends. You cannot Pass while Preparing.
Watching, Deceiving & Helping:
Roll one Awareness against the Stealth of anything Hiding, or against a Threshold the GM sets for a hidden object. Covers everything within 30 feet.
Critical Success As Success, but the creature moves two states. Success The creature moves one state toward Observed: Undetected becomes Hidden, Hidden becomes Concealed, Concealed becomes Observed. Failure You learn nothing. Critical Failure You commit to the wrong place. You are Wrong-Footed to that creature until your next Opportunity.

Requirements You are currently benefiting from at least Lesser Cover, or from Concealment.
Roll one Stealth against the Awareness of every creature around you (including your allies).
Critical Success You are Hidden to the creature, and they are Wrong-Footed to you until the end of the next round. Success You are Hidden to the creature. Failure They still see you. Critical Failure You have drawn the eye. You are Wrong-Footed to that creature until your next Opportunity.

Requirements You are (or believe you are) currently at least Hidden from at least one creature.
Move up to half your Speed while staying Hidden or Undetected. You must end this movement with Concealment or at least Lesser Cover from each creature you wish to remain at least Hidden from. Roll one Stealth against the Awareness of every creature to which you are currently at least Hidden (including your allies).
Critical Success You move and remain Hidden and/or Undetected, and they are Wrong-Footed to you until the end of the next round. Success You move and remain Hidden and/or Undetected. Failure You are Observed during your movement. Critical Failure You are Observed, and you are Wrong-Footed to them until your next Opportunity.
❷ Creep. As above, except: Failure You realize you would be Observed if you moved, and may choose not to move after all. Critical Failure You are Observed during your movement.

Indicate a creature you have located, whether you can see it or it is merely Hidden to you. It becomes Hidden rather than Undetected, or Concealed rather than Hidden, to any ally who can hear or see you.

Roll Intimidation against the target's Guard.
Critical Success The target is Frightened 2. Success The target is Frightened 1. Failure No effect. Critical Failure No effect, and it is emboldened: +1 Situation bonus to its Attacks against you until the end of the next round.
❷ Break Them. Critical Success The target is Frightened 3 and Heedless. Success The target is Frightened 2. Failure The target is Frightened 1. Critical Failure No effect.

Roll Guile against the target's Awareness.
Critical Success The target is Wrong-Footed to you until the end of the next round. Success The target is Wrong-Footed to you until the end of your next Opportunity. Failure No effect. Critical Failure You overcommit. You are Wrong-Footed to that creature until your next Opportunity.

Prepare ❶ at one of your Opportunities, naming one ally and the task you intend to help with. When they attempt it before your next Opportunity, use a Reaction ⓿↺ to roll a relevant check against Threshold 15.
Critical Success They gain a +2 Situation bonus. Success +1 Situation bonus. Failure No effect. Critical Failure They take a −1 Situation penalty.
Your preparation is spent whether or not they attempt the task.

Learn something true about a creature, place, or object. Possible topics include Defense Thresholds, Protection and armor materials, Weaknesses, Resistances and Immunities, Attack Thresholds, Special Abilities, and maximum Vigor.
Roll a Lore or relevant Skill check against the level-based Threshold of your target.
Critical Success You recall all facts about two topics. Success You recall all facts about one topic. Failure You recall nothing. Critical Failure You recall all (incorrect) facts about one topic.
Special You may attempt this once per target per Skill, so a character with several Lores or relevant Skills may get several angles on the same problem.
❷ Study. As above, except: Critical Failure You recall nothing.
Handling Things: Draw or stow a weapon, open a door, pull a potion from your pack, pick something up, work a lever.
Drop or let go of something you are holding.
Special: Name one creature or object Observed by you. Watch its feet, its shadow, the floor in front of it. Until your next Opportunity you gain a +2 Situation bonus to your Defenses against its effects with the Visual trait, and it is Concealed to you.

Trigger You fall past an edge, ledge, or handhold within your reach. Requirements You have a hand free; you may Release ⓿ an item as part of this Reaction to free a hand.
Roll Athletics or Acrobatics against a Threshold of 15.
Critical Success You catch it and pull yourself up in the same motion. You do not fall. Success You catch it and hang there. You are Off-Guard. Failure You fall, but the damage from the falling distance is reduced by 10 feet. Critical Failure You fall the full distance.

explorationActions: When an encounter begins, you can roll Awareness.
When an encounter begins, you can roll Athletics.
Roll an Awareness check; the GM applies it to the Thresholds to spot hidden objects and creatures. When an encounter begins, you can roll Awareness.
Every ally gains a +1 Situation bonus to initiative, and you may Step ⓿ when you roll initiative. When an encounter begins, you can roll Awareness.
Your shield begins Raised and a weapon is already in hand. When an encounter begins, you can roll Awareness.

Roll a relevant Lore or Skill check; the GM applies it to the Thresholds to potentially recall relevant information about your surroundings. When an encounter begins, you can roll the same Lore or Skill check, if the encounter is related to what you are Investigating.

Hands empty, eyes down, pace unhurried. You are not hiding. You are simply not worth watching.
Requirements You wield no weapon with a Reach greater than Adjacent, and your worn armor totals Load 1 or less.
When an encounter begins, you may roll Guile for Initiative. Compare the roll against the Awareness of each enemy you are Observed to.
Critical Success They are Wrong-Footed to you until the end of your first Opportunity. Success They are Wrong-Footed to your first attack. Failure Nothing; they were watching you all along. Critical Failure You overplayed it. You are Wrong-Footed to them until your next Opportunity.
Outside an encounter, a successful Guile check lets you approach, pass, or linger without being challenged by anyone who would otherwise have wanted to know your business.
downtimeActions: Move 1 already spent Talent Point to another Talent you qualify for. You cannot retrain away from a Talent in your Origin Constellation, a Root Talent, a Talent that another Talent you own requires, or a Talent that would reduce your Proficiency Rank in a Constellation.
You work with a teacher, a rival, or a manual. A Constellation of your choice becomes Flared. You may benefit from Train only once between Milestones.

Buy and sell in a settlement. Common goods are simply available. For anything uncommon, roll a relevant Skill or Lore against a Threshold the GM sets to find someone who has one. You sell at half price.
conditions: −2 Situation to Evade and Guard against all foes.
−N to all checks and Thresholds; reduce by 1 at the end of each round.
Off-Guard, −2 to Attacks; +2 Situation to Evade vs. ranged Attacks. Stand ❶ to clear.
Off-Guard and can't Move or Step; Escape ❶ to break free.
Commitment so complete that you have stopped thinking. Maneuvers with Concentrate take 1 extra action.
As Grabbed but can't take any action other than Escape ❶.
Lose the next N actions; may carry over across rounds.
Lose N actions at the start of each round. Reduce by 1 at the end of each round.
−1 to Evade and Guard; can't use Exploration Mode Activities.
Take it at the end of each round; Endure check (10 + the amount of persistent damage you just took) to end.
You're Dying (see Chapter 2: Core Rules), and you're also unconscious.
That Zone carries a Wound: its critical effect made lasting (see Chapter 2: Vigor & Wounds). Fill the Torso's or Head's Wound capacity (two, for anyone Medium or smaller) and you are Dying.
You have 0 Vigor. Every Hit that lands on you Wounds the Zone struck; a Critical Hit inflicts two. Grazes never Wound.
Your implement is in a neutral Bind with X's. The Bind ends if either of you Moves, Steps, or Recenters, or when a Strike between you resolves.
X Controls your weapon. You have an Exposed Zone of X's choice while the Bind lasts, and your attacks with that weapon take a −2 Situation penalty. Recenter ❶ or Step to end it.
You Control X's weapon: X has an Exposed Zone of your choice. You may Close ❶ on X. The Bind ends if a third party attacks you.
You have begun a Maneuver of three or more actions: one action spent, the rest reserved. You cannot Pass; you finish or abandon at your next Opportunity. Taking a Wound abandons it.
That Zone is Exposed: ordinary Hits can land there instead of your Torso. Recenter ❶ to clear, unless a Posture Exposed it: that lasts until the end of the round.
Cannot see. Cannot Observe any creature. Is Off-Guard.
Cannot hear. Immune to any Auditory Maneuver or Activity.
You are out, Dying or knocked cold: you drop everything you are holding in your squares, and you're also Prone.
zones: The target is Off-Guard until it Recenters.
As left, and if the Strike was Deliberate or Committed, the Zone is Wounded (see Vigor & Wounds).
The target takes a −2 Situation penalty to attack rolls until it Recenters.
As left, and if the Strike was Deliberate or Committed, the Zone is Wounded (see Vigor & Wounds).
The target's Speed is halved until it Recenters.
As left, and if the Strike was Deliberate or Committed, the Zone is Wounded (see Vigor & Wounds).
The target cannot use Reactions until it Recenters.
As left, and if the Strike was Deliberate or Committed, the Zone is Wounded (see Vigor & Wounds).
detection: Exactly what squares you are in, and precisely where you are positioned.
Your foe can plainly see all of you.
Exactly what squares you are in, but something is preventing them from seeing or otherwise detecting all of you.
You gain a +2 Situation bonus to Evade and Guard for physical Attacks.
You are surrounded in mist, or you are in dim light, or you are hiding in foliage.
That you are present, but not what squares you occupy.
Your foe must successfully guess one of the squares you occupy in order to attack you. Even so, you gain a +4 Situation bonus to Evade and Guard for physical Attacks. Your foe is Wrong-Footed to you.
Your foe is blind, or you have succeeded on a Sneak check.
Has no idea if you are even present.
You cannot be targeted at all. Your foe is Wrong-Footed to you.
Your foe cannot see, hear, smell, or feel you.
light: They are Hidden to you (or possibly Undetected, if you did not already know something was there).
cover: +1 Situation bonus to your Evade and Guard for physical Attacks.
+2 Situation bonus to your Evade and Guard for physical Attacks.
+4 Situation bonus to your Evade and Guard for physical Attacks.
You cannot be targeted at all for physical Attacks.
damageOrder: Add up all of the remaining dice, damage bonuses, and damage modifiers.
Add Weakness of the applicable damage type(s).
Subtract Resistance from the dice rolls of the applicable damage type(s).
Double the total if it was a Critical Hit.
Subtract Protection from the total (if applicable).
Deal damage to Temporary Vigor (if applicable).
protectionSteps: If the Zone is Exposed and the Strike is Deliberate or Committed, its Protection is 0; you can stop here. (A Quick Strike always meets full Protection.)
Start with the Protection of the piece worn there. No piece worn means 0.
Add any bonus that applies to that Zone (a matched harness adds 1 to your Torso; some Talents add to every Zone).
Subtract 1 if the incoming damage type is the one that piece's material turns poorly. A Zone with no armor has no material, and so has no such weakness.
Subtract any Protection the attacker ignores.
recovery: Your Dying ends. You are conscious, on your feet if you spend an action to stand, with 1 Vigor.
Your Dying value drops by 1. If it reaches 0, your Dying ends and you are stable: still unconscious, but no longer sliding.
chargenSteps: Your body and blood. This forms the core of your Origin Constellation and gives you starting Vigor, Speed, and unique characteristics (e.g., keen eyes).
Vigor per level, Size, Speed, and 1 Special Ability.
Your lineage. This adds a branch to your Origin Constellation and gives you additional unique characteristics.
Where you were raised. This adds a branch to your Origin Constellation and gives you additional customization options.
Starting language(s), and a bonus to Diplomacy checks with those who share your Culture.
Your trade. This grants 1 Lore Talent Point and 2 Skill Talent Points.
Your adventuring identity. This adds special techniques such as entering a rage or sneak attacking.
Training in one Skill or other Constellation, Vigor per level, and a signature ability.

Your defensive posture. You begin Trained in two of the four Defenses (Awareness, Evade, Guard, and Endure), your choice. Each answers two of the four kinds of threat (Blows, Blasts, Blights, Beguilement), so two Trained Defenses cover three kinds and leave one gap; choose the pair whose gap you can live with.
Two Trained Defenses. A Defense you leave Untrained still adds its Attribute, but every Threshold that depends on it is 3 lower.
Comets, which are Talent Points that can be used for any purpose (as long as you still meet the prerequisite).
Melee Training or Ranged Training, your choice: every character begins Trained in one of them. It is granted automatically, not spent from the steps above.

Trained in Melee or Ranged: +3 to Strikes with a weapon in your hand, or with one that leaves it. A completed 1st-level character has spent at least 14 Talent Points, 13 from the steps above plus this one.
